subject.title: fix(telegram): preserve word boundaries in proactive sends

question: Should this PR wait for candidate-only Telegram Desktop proof, or should the assigned owner explicitly override the external-PR proof gate based on the focused tests and green exact-head CI?
rationale: Automation cannot treat the canceled Mantis build as behavior evidence or decide that the repository's external-PR live-proof requirement should be waived.

options.title: Run candidate-only Telegram proof
options.body: Use a maintainer-capable Mantis run to record the long proactive Markdown result and verify each visible boundary plus complete joined text.

options.title: Explicitly override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the remaining delivery uncertainty through the repository's proof-override mechanism after reviewing the focused tests and exact-head checks.

recommendation.title: Run candidate-only Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Use a maintainer-capable Mantis run to record the long proactive Markdown result and verify each visible boundary plus complete joined text.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and can authorize or perform the maintainer-only Telegram proof step.
